source: questions staff asked on the deployed Sakshi archive assistant (query history 2026-07-16 .. 2026-11-12: 250 queries, 28 users) and its 55 answer-feedback entries, read on 2026-11-13

fields.kind: person | all_articles | pressmeet | incident | topic | latest | timeline | fact | compare | followup | other (assigned by hand)
fields.lang: te (Telugu script) | latin (English or Telugu typed in Latin letters) | mixed
fields.asked / users: times the exact question was asked / by how many staff
fields.old_failed: of those, how often the old system answered 'no information', refused the name or returned no answer
fields.filters: filters the user set in the old UI (state, category, date range)
fields.ratings: the user's ratings of the old answer, 1-10
fields.feedback: the user's comment on the old answer, summarised in English
fields.expect: what a good answer must do, taken from the feedback; `check` is one of the keys of expect_checks

caveats: No gold story ids: the questions are about January-June 2026 and the new stores hold October-November 2026 (plus 4 older days). `story_on` names the story by print date instead.
Questions were retyped from the site; invisible joiner characters (ZWNJ) some users typed inside Telugu words are not kept. Spelling mistakes are kept.
Exact repeats are one row (`asked` counts them); 5 near-identical retypes and one comment typed into the question box dropped.
No user names or e-mail addresses are stored.
